answer_1.quote: MIMO-VLA demonstrates that task-adaptive distributed output mapping not only enables efficient multimodal collaboration but also resolves the interference bottleneck of existing MISO models.

answer_2.quote: We deployed our trained model on a vehicle for autonomous urban navigation and evaluated its performance using established metrics: Collision Rate (CR), Off-road Rate (OR), Episode Completion Rate (ER), Average Safe Driving Distance (ASD), Average Reward (AR), and Driving Score (DS).

answer_3.quote: Building on this finding, we employed GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2023a) to systematically compare the answer quality of MIMO-VLA with baseline models.
